description: This file contains a Swift implementation of a parser for assistant text segments, which processes raw text input and identifies segments based on markup tags like <think> and <final>. It defines data structures and parsing logic for extracting and handling different types of assistant response segments.

classes.name: AssistantTextSegment
classes.description: A data structure representing a segment of assistant text, with an identifier, a kind (thinking or response), and the text content.

methods.name: segments(from:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Parses raw input text and splits it into segments based on markup tags, optionally including segments marked as 'thinking'.

methods.name: visibleSegments(from:)
methods.description: Returns only the response segments, excluding 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Checks if the raw input contains any visible response content, optionally including 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:)
methods.description: Checks if the raw input contains any visible response content, excluding 'thinking' segments.
